opening_message:
Ticket 1: Alyssa Rose (employee ID E026) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E026.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: E026 (Alyssa Rose) is a full-time Analyst requesting write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin requires owning the role (Payroll Specialist), which does not apply. Requested write is within policy, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E026 (Alyssa Rose) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training (never admin). Requested write exceeds the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: Conflicting notes: HR lists E026 as full-time Analyst (recommends write), while Security lists E026 as contractor with basic security training (recommends read). Contractors with basic training max out at read; the write request exceeds the contractor maximum. Given conflicting employment data and the Security record indicating contractor status with basic training, the appropriate grant is the maximum allowed: read.
